real_architecture_summary: Browser (React+Vite SPA, JA/EN i18n) --HTTPS--> CloudFront --OAC/SigV4--> private S3 bucket (BlockPublicAccess ALL) holding frontend dist/ + config.json{apiBaseUrl}. SPA reads config.json then calls API Gateway v2 HTTP API (CORS) with 4 routes -> 4 Lambdas: GET /monster/{monsterId}=getMonster (DynamoDB R/W), POST /monster=saveMonster (DynamoDB W), POST /battle=battle (DynamoDB R/W), POST /chat=chat (DynamoDB R + Bedrock InvokeModel). Single DynamoDB table DigitalMonsterStack-Monsters, PK=id, PAY_PER_REQUEST. ONLY the chat Lambda has bedrock:InvokeModel (scoped to the 3 Claude inference-profile ARNs + underlying foundation-model ARNs); other 3 Lambdas have NO Bedrock perm. Bedrock Claude tier by growth stage: baby=none (canned reply, no Bedrock call), rookie=Haiku, champion=Sonnet, ultimate=Opus. Region us-east-1. All of frontend dist + config.json deployed to S3 via CDK BucketDeployment. Do NOT hardcode per-deploy CloudFront/API URLs into the diagram.
